name: dev.ucp.common.ui
title: UI Extension
description: Extends Capabilities with an optional declarative UI rendition of the response. The containing response is the rendition's data; the response remains complete without it.

formats.description: UI formats keyed by media type (e.g. 'application/a2ui+json'). Each value is that format's own capability object, passed through verbatim as defined by the format's UCP binding.

rendition.title: UI Rendition
rendition.description: A declarative rendition of the containing response in one negotiated UI format.

type.description: Media type of `content`. MUST be a format declared in the platform's `formats`. MUST NOT be an executable format such as HTML or JavaScript.

content.description: Format-native payload, interpreted per the format's UCP binding. For 'application/a2ui+json': an array of A2UI messages.

platform_schema.title: UI Extension (Platform)
platform_schema.description: Platform-level UI extension declaration. Platforms declare the UI formats they can render in 'config.formats'.

formats.description: UI formats the platform can render, with each format's renderer capabilities.

business_schema.title: UI Extension (Business)
business_schema.description: Business-level UI extension declaration. Businesses MAY declare the UI formats they can emit in 'config.formats'; the declaration is informational.

formats.description: UI formats the business can emit.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.title: Catalog Search with UI
dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.search.description: Catalog Search response extended with an optional UI rendition.

dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.title: Catalog Lookup with UI
dev.ucp.shopping.catalog.lookup.description: Catalog Lookup response extended with an optional UI rendition.

dev.ucp.shopping.cart.title: Cart with UI
dev.ucp.shopping.cart.description: Cart extended with an optional UI rendition.
